spec.assertion: All three skill1 blocks are trigger hitCount count:30, and doubling the threshold halves the activation count (0.35–0.65 ratio). RED under shotFired (activations would be in the thousands, >400 bound), RED under interval/lastBullet (no response to the threshold patch).

hitRatePct 5.44 apply target set equals the full 4-slug roster and count == activations x 4. RED under self-only or SMG-scoped modelling. Re-scoping the block to self moves at least one teammate's total and leaves miranda's byte-identical — proves the grant is a live team channel (hrCoreMult).

hitRatePct 3.79 target set contains miranda (SMG, self is in scope), excludes helm (SR), is a strict subset of the 5.44 set, and count == activations x |SMG set|. RED if the weapon scope is dropped and the block is modelled as plain 'allies'.

atkPct 50.06 applies target only miranda (inertness: no teammate ever receives it), and collapsing the window to 0.5s lowers her total while every teammate stays byte-identical. RED under an allies-scoped model and under a permanent/untimed buff.

critDamagePct 32.99 apply count == fullBurstStart x roster size, target set == full roster. RED under a burstCast keying (miranda is a B1 sharing stage 1 with liter, so own-cast count != FB count) and under any self/partial scope.

critRatePct 30.1 and attackDamagePct 23.7 each apply exactly FB times, always targeting miranda. RED if either is emitted to allies, or if attackDamagePct is mis-bucketed as a generic atkPct (the stat filter fails).
Exactly FB applies of critRatePct 85.42, never targeting miranda. RED if excludeSelf is dropped (the caster becomes eligible) or if the count field is not 1.

Every 85.42 buffApply carries durationShots === 1 (round-count expiry). RED under the classic nearest-wrong durationSec:1, which emits no durationShots; the counterfactual run swapping durationShots for durationSec:1 also changes the team total, so the two readings are not damage-equivalent.

spec.kitLine: No activation clause → own burst cast
spec.assertion: Non-vacuity gate: at least one pair of 56.23 applies must exist, i.e. miranda wins stage 1 at least once in the control comp. A failure here is a FIXTURE finding (B1 contention with liter), reported separately from the semantics tests.

Applies chunk into pairs: each cast emits exactly 2 applies per stat, to 2 DISTINCT allies, neither of them miranda; the atkPct and critDamagePct target multisets match. RED if count:1 or count:3, if excludeSelf is dropped, or if the two stats are split onto different target sets.

fixtures: controlComp('miranda', true) only — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / miranda / helm (B3). helm is kept because her B3 is what actually drives Full Bursts here: miranda is BURST I, so she contends with liter for stage 1 and cannot be relied on to complete the chain herself. That makes helm's presence load-bearing for every skill2 assertion, and it also supplies a non-SMG (SR) ally, which is exactly what discriminates the weapon-scoped 3.79% Hit Rate line from the unscoped 5.44% one. 5 hoisted runs: BASE, hitCount x2 (trigger identity), self-ATK window 0.5s (self scope + timed), 5.44 Hit Rate re-scoped to self (team-grant liveness), and durationShots→durationSec:1 (round semantics). All counterfactuals locate their block STRUCTURALLY by the kit magnitude it carries, so no block-index assumption about the driver's authoring order is baked in; a missing magnitude throws with a named error rather than silently passing.
gaps: it.skip — exact 5 sec / 10 sec buff windows: the S1 hit-count trigger re-fires about every 2s, so a 5 sec window and a permanent buff are behaviourally identical in this fixture. The 0.5s counterfactual proves the window is honoured at all, but pinning its exact length needs the apply frame alongside expiresFrame, which the buffApply payload does not expose.

it.skip — byFinalAtk vs static-ATK ranking for the 'highest final ATK' target sets (S2c and burst): the control comp's live and static ATK orderings of the three non-miranda allies do not demonstrably diverge, and the harness exposes no per-unit ATK accessor to construct the discriminating case blind. The exclude-self and count facets ARE pinned; only the ranking basis is unverified.

FLAG (not a kit line) — the Hit Rate lines are the ALWAYS-flag 'Hit Rate → core magnitude' class: their damage effect rides the sim's hrCoreMult, which is a derived/measured channel, not a kit-stated quantity. The tests assert scope and liveness (teammates move when the scope is patched), never a magnitude.

FIXTURE RISK (asserted, not skipped) — miranda is BURST I and controlComp already contains liter (B1). If the rotation never awards her stage 1, the burst non-vacuity test goes RED and the burst target-set assertions become untested; that RED is the intended signal to rebuild the fixture without liter, not evidence of an override defect.
